{{Top|leg}}
The '''cybernetic respirator''' was a [[Cybernetics/Legends|implant]] designed to augment the [[Lung/Legends|lungs]].

Robust and resilient, a cybernetic [[Breath mask/Legends|respirator]] filtered out many different [[Poison/Legends|toxins]] and even allowed for breathing underwater, or survival in a completely [[Vacuum/Legends|airless]] environment for a time. Used by organics wishing to escape fleshly frailties, various models existed, with some producing an ominous rasp, while others were completely silent.
